page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ise.2xlarge belongs to the Enhanced ecs.g8ise server family, providing general-purpose compute capacity built on the x86_64 architecture. Virtualized via KVM, the configuration provides 8 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system includes 32.0 GB of memory, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB per core. The instance operates without GPU accelerators, focusing entirely on standard central processing tasks.

From an I/O and connectivity perspective, ecs.g8ise.2xlarge features a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The instance is diskless, meaning zero local storage is attached to the physical host configuration. As a result, operating system deployment and persistent application data handling depend on attached cloud block storage. This separation of compute and storage facilitates stateless horizontal scaling and volume mobility, though workloads that rely on high-throughput local scratch disks must account for network-attached storage latency.

In terms of qualitative efficiency, dedicated CPU resource mapping ensures consistent execution free from noisy-neighbor contention found in shared-core tiers. With its balanced core-to-memory ratio, ecs.g8ise.2xlarge provides resource density aligned with enterprise workloads. The configuration is technically well matched for multi-tier web applications, backend microservices, container nodes, continuous integration pipelines, and transactional database instances backed by remote persistent storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ise.2xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose compute instance from the Enhanced ecs.g8ise family, virtualized on KVM. The server is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor clocked at 2.7 GHz, paired with 32.0 GB of system memory to maintain a balanced 1:4 core-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is not present, with zero GPUs included in the profile. Local physical storage is also absent, requiring external block storage solutions for persistent file systems and operating system volumes. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps, while public IPv4 addresses are not bundled by default. Operating with dedicated host resources, the configuration offers predictable core execution without resource contention. The instance provides a cost-effective, general-purpose platform tailored for web serving tiers, application microservices, containerized workloads, CI/CD runners, and mid-sized transactional databases relying on remote storage volumes.
